target.title: fix(feishu): propagate media-retry error on file download fallback and catch streaming-card flush rejection
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

- **media.ts**: When saving a Feishu file resource failed with HTTP 502, the code retried as type "media". If the retry also failed, the original 502 error was incorrectly re-thrown instead of the retry error, masking the actual failure reason (e.g. auth failure, rate limit, or network error on the media API).
- **streaming-card.ts**: The scheduled flush update in FeishuStreamingSession called `this.update(pending)` without catching potential rejections, which could cause unhandled promise rejections when card content updates fail transiently.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Remove the unnecessary try/catch wrapper in the media-retry fallback path so the retry error propagates naturally to the caller instead of being replaced by the original 502 error.
- Add a `.catch()` with diagnostic logging to the scheduled flush timer,'s `update()` call so transient card update failures are visible without causing unhandled promise rejections.

## User Impact

Users on Feishu channels will get accurate error messages when file resource downloads fall back from "file" to "media" type and the retry also fails — the actual retry error is now visible rather than masked by the original 502. Scheduled streaming-card updates that fail transiently will log a diagnostic instead of producing an unhandled promise rejection.

## Evidence

### 1. Focused unit test — media-retry error propagation

The test `"rethrowing the media-retry error instead of the original 502 when the retry fails"` asserts that when both file (502) and media (403) downloads fail, the retry error (403) is the one that propagates, not the original 502. This is the inverse of the prior (buggy) behavior.

```
 ✓ |extension-feishu| ... > saveMessageResourceFeishu > retries file resources as media after HTTP 502 9ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| ... > saveMessageResourceFeishu > rethrows the media-retry error instead of the original 502 when the retry fails 1ms
 ✓ |extension-feishu| ... > saveMessageResourceFeishu > does not retry non-fallback download failures 1ms
```

### 2. Full test suite (44/44 passed)

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/media.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  44 passed (44)
   Start at  10:21:17
   Duration  4.36s
```

### 3. Format / Lint / Typecheck

```
pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/media.ts extensions/feishu/src/media.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.ts
  All matched files use the correct format.

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.scripts.json extensions/feishu/src/media.ts extensions/feishu/src/media.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.ts
  oxlint_exit=0

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json ...
  exit=0

git diff --check
  exit=0
```

### 4. Source code proof — streaming-card .catch()

The `.catch()` handler on the flush timer update is present in the committed source:

```typescript
void this.update(pending).catch((e: unknown) =>
  this.log?.(`Scheduled flush update failed: ${String(e)}`),
);
```

### 5. Diff summary

```
 extensions/feishu/src/media.test.ts     |  9 ++++-----
 extensions/feishu/src/media.ts          | 20 ++++++++------------
 extensions/feishu/src/streaming-card.ts |  4 +++-
 3 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 18 deletions(-)
```
